threat_event: Ransomware encrypts EHR and ancillary servers in DC1 and DC2, forcing downtime at all 9 hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Shared directory forest; no clean recovery environment; restore from vault untested
likelihood_basis: EV-009 (shared directory forest); EV-021 (no full EHR restore in the log); EV-046 (no clean recovery environment)
existing_controls: EDR; SOC; immutable vault; DC2 failover
treatment_plan: Clean recovery environment and restore test (POAM-012); zone separation (POAM-007)
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: EHR downtime longer than the MTD leads to medication errors, missed critical results, or delayed treatment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Downtime procedures built for hours; paper MARs and results for days not practiced at scale
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (downtime procedures written for hours); EV-093 (clinical leaders' interviews)
existing_controls: Downtime workstations; downtime super users; paper kits
treatment_plan: Multi-day downtime drill at the flagship and one community hospital; paper MAR and result routing procedure for outages over 24 hours (POAM-009)

threat_event: Patient data is exfiltrated before encryption (double extortion)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Large data stores in DC1; egress alerting basic
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (data stores in DC1); EV-010 (outbound volume rule only)
existing_controls: EDR; network detection at the data center edge
treatment_plan: Egress baselines for EHR reporting servers and file shares
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: An unsupported-OS medical device is exploited, changing device behavior or taking it offline
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 6,900 devices on unsupported operating systems; manufacturers slow to patch
likelihood_basis: EV-054 (about 6,900 devices on unsupported operating systems)
existing_controls: Device risk review at purchase; inventory 81%
treatment_plan: Isolate unsupported devices in restricted zones; replacement plan in the capital budget

threat_event: A device vendor's remote support connection is used to reach device networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 37 of 140 vendor connections bypass PAM and stay connected
likelihood_basis: EV-056 (37 of 140 connections bypass PAM); EV-093 (vendor access practice)
treatment_plan: Move the 37 connections into PAM with session approval and recording (POAM-013)

threat_event: Flat device networks at 4 hospitals let malware move from user workstations to devices and OT
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Segmentation done at 5 of 9 hospitals
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (segmentation at 5 of 9 hospitals)
existing_controls: Segmented networks at 5 hospitals; EDR on workstations
treatment_plan: Complete segmentation at the remaining 4 hospitals (POAM-015)
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: Student and trainee accounts stay active after rotations or are shared between students
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Emailed rosters; no end dates; password only; 412 stale accounts in the July 2026 sample
likelihood_basis: EV-042 (emailed rosters; no end dates; password only); EV-C1-AC-2 (412 stale accounts, July 2026 extract)
treatment_plan: Identity governance with end dates and MFA (POAM-001); monthly reconciliation with schools (POAM-014)
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: A workforce member views a coworker's, celebrity's, or family member's record without need
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: About 34,000 users with broad clinical access
likelihood_basis: EV-041 (about 34,000 users); EV-044 (privacy monitoring)
existing_controls: Privacy monitoring tool; weekly review; sanctions
treatment_plan: Tune monitoring rules for cross-site access; quarterly manager reports

threat_event: The sepsis model under-detects sepsis in some patient groups or hospitals, delaying treatment
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor default threshold at all 9 hospitals; validated only at the flagship; 92.210 identification and mitigation not documented (group gap 6)
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (default threshold; flagship validation only; no 92.210 record)
existing_controls: Nurse sepsis screening protocol at triage
treatment_plan: Validation at all 9 hospitals; universal screening; documented 92.210 steps; threshold review (POAM-024; P10)

threat_event: Alert fatigue from the sepsis model causes clinicians to ignore true alerts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: High alert volume at the default threshold
likelihood_basis: EV-064 (default threshold; dismiss reasons recorded); EV-093 (alert volume)
treatment_plan: Silent-mode test of a hospital-specific threshold; clinician training (P10)

threat_event: A system-wide IT outage overwhelms hospital incident command; diversion and transfers are not coordinated across 9 hospitals
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Unified emergency plan has no system-wide IT outage scenario or diversion criteria (group gap 2)
likelihood_basis: EV-057 (no system-wide IT outage scenario or diversion criteria)
existing_controls: Hurricane and surge plans; hospital incident command
treatment_plan: Add a cyber and IT outage annex with diversion criteria; exercise it as the additional annual exercise (POAM-023)

threat_event: A clinical application vendor's standing account is used to change EHR or ancillary configuration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor accounts through PAM but with broad rights
likelihood_basis: EV-008 (vendor accounts through PAM with broad rights)
treatment_plan: Least-privilege vendor roles; quarterly vendor access review

threat_event: A malicious or faulty update to an ancillary clinical system corrupts results or drug data
threat_source: Supply chain attacker or vendor error
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Updates tested for function in staging; integrity of packages not verified
likelihood_basis: EV-045 (function testing in staging; package integrity not verified)
treatment_plan: Verify package signatures; second-pharmacist review of drug library imports

threat_event: The imaging archive tier at provider A is exposed by misconfiguration
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Guardrails block public access
likelihood_basis: EV-019 (guardrails block public access; private link only)
treatment_plan: Quarterly configuration review

threat_event: Attackers exploit missing patches on ancillary clinical servers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Median 47 days to apply critical patches; 11 servers on an unsupported operating system
likelihood_basis: EV-050 (median 47 days; 11 unsupported servers)
existing_controls: Monthly OS patching; weekly scans; restricted zones
treatment_plan: Vendor validation within 14 days; replace unsupported servers (POAM-010)

threat_event: Admission notices sent to the Health Plan include more PHI than needed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full ADT segments; no written protocol
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (full ADT segments); EV-053 (no minimum-necessary protocol)
treatment_plan: Minimum-necessary protocol and reduced feed (POAM-016)

threat_event: A community-connect practice user's account is compromised and used to browse the shared EHR
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 64 practices with their own identity providers; MFA by contract attestation only
likelihood_basis: EV-062 (practice MFA attested, not verified)
treatment_plan: Verify practice MFA technically at federation; practice access reviews (P09)

threat_event: A hurricane cuts a coastal hospital's WAN links and building system monitoring
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Diverse carriers; generator monitoring on the network
likelihood_basis: EV-017 (diverse carriers); EV-059 (generators monitored on the network)
treatment_plan: Annual carrier diversity test

threat_event: Interface engine service account credentials are stolen and reused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 63 interface and service accounts with static passwords older than 1 year; 9 of them stored in plain text in configuration files (found in P07)
likelihood_basis: EV-052 (63 static passwords older than 1 year); EV-C1-IA-5 (9 stored in plain text, P07)
treatment_plan: Vault and rotate service credentials (POAM-002)

threat_event: Hospital breach notices are late because affected patients must be counted by state across 3 states
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Notification matrix not exercised; counts by state need manual work
likelihood_basis: EV-012 (matrix not exercised); EV-038 (counts by state from a manual query)
treatment_plan: Exercise the matrix; prepare state count queries in advance (POAM-005)

threat_event: Components feeding the HCIS are missing from the inventory, so they are not scanned or restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Interfaced devices not linked to interfaces in the inventory
likelihood_basis: EV-040 (interfaced devices not linked in the inventory)
regulatory_driver: C-HPH-R01 (164.310(d)(1)); C-HPH-R03 (proposed asset inventory, tracked only)
treatment_plan: Link interfaced devices to interfaces (POAM-011)

threat_event: Clinicians are phished and approve MFA prompts, giving attackers remote access
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: MFA push approvals; phishing-resistant MFA only for administrators
likelihood_basis: EV-005 (push MFA with number matching); EV-027 (monthly phishing exercises)
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant MFA for remote access (GR-08 plan)
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: Paper records from a long downtime are lost or not entered into the EHR
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Back-entry procedure designed for short outages
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (back-entry written for short outages)
treatment_plan: Back-entry procedure for outages longer than 24 hours (POAM-009)

threat_event: An encrypted workstation on wheels is stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Full-disk encryption on all workstations
likelihood_basis: EV-049 (full-disk encryption on all workstations)
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Hospital System security and compliance lead (encrypted device is not a breach of unsecured PHI)
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: Building automation is tampered with through the OT network, affecting negative-pressure rooms or temperatures
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: OT shares flat networks at 4 hospitals
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (OT on flat networks at 4 hospitals); EV-054 (building automation)
treatment_plan: OT segmentation with device networks (POAM-015)

threat_event: The telehealth vendor has a breach of visit data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor under BAA with SOC 2 Type 2 report
likelihood_basis: EV-061 (telehealth BAA); EV-031 (telehealth SOC 2 Type 2)
treatment_plan: Accepted at Low by the Hospital System security and compliance lead
owner: Hospital System security and compliance lead

threat_event: Public health feeds stop during an outage, so reportable results are late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feeds depend on the interface engine
likelihood_basis: EV-051 (public health feeds through the interface engine)
existing_controls: Phone and fax fallback for urgent conditions
treatment_plan: Add public health reporting to the downtime checklist

threat_event: Patient portal accounts are taken over with reused passwords
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal MFA optional
likelihood_basis: EV-063 (portal MFA optional)
treatment_plan: Offer and promote MFA; step-up for proxy access changes

threat_event: Downtime workstations fail during an outage at the 3 hospitals where they were not tested
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No test in the last 12 months at 3 community hospitals
likelihood_basis: EV-048 (no test in 12 months at 3 community hospitals)
treatment_plan: Monthly automated report checks and quarterly unit tests (POAM-009)

threat_event: Infusion pump drug libraries are altered, causing wrong dose limits
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drug library server on a segmented network at 5 hospitals only
likelihood_basis: EV-055 (drug library server segmented at 5 hospitals only)
treatment_plan: Change alerting on drug library servers; segmentation at 4 hospitals
